obligations.note: AppLog.java is in scope, and the change only raises MAX_LINES from 10,000 to 12,000, which does not change what is written to a log line. The only control test is labelled sample, its CI report cannot be tied to the head commit, and no exhaustive evidence exists for this exhaustive-evidence obligation.
Ticket CHG-26551 is standard and approved by change manager grace.kim on 2026-10-23, before review. Its components (mortgage.logging) cover AppLog.java, the only changed path.
declan.farrell holds change_approver for baseline-mortgage, is a different person from author Wen Li, and approved code_review on head bdc19ef.
Both approvals name the single and final commit bdc19ef, so no later commits exist.

run.json claims a CI run on head bdc19ef on ci-runner-04 starting 2026-10-24T20:02Z. Every JUnit report it lists is timestamped 2026-10-23T13:51, more than a day before the head commit existed, and comes from host dev-laptop-7.local, a developer machine. The reports therefore cannot show the suite or the LOG-1 control test passing on the final commit.
mortgage.logging is security_sensitive. kofi.mensah, a security_reviewer, gave a security_review approval on head bdc19ef.
No protected path (controls/, control tests, ci/) is touched, so no control_owner approval is required.
The change and its ticket are standard, not emergency, so no PIR is required.
No exception is relied on for this change. EXC-0167 exists for LOG-1/mortgage.logging but is not needed to cover any deviation here.
No acceptance-ledger entry covers AppLog.java, so no earlier evidence lapses.

summary: PR-1218 changes only the in-memory log buffer size in the security-sensitive AppLog. Ticket, independent code review and security review are all in order on the head commit. However, the CI evidence is invalid: the JUnit reports attached to a run claiming the head commit were produced on a developer's laptop a day before that commit existed. Testing on the final commit (CHG-4) is therefore refuted, and LOG-1 cannot be established from sample-only, unattributable test results. The change is rejected until a genuine CI run on bdc19ef is supplied.
